audience: school transport coordinators who follow buses, routes and trips in SchoolBusTrack

useCases.title: See where the buses are right now
useCases.text: List the latest position of every bus, with speed and whether the fix is stale. Open one bus to read its last known location.

useCases.title: Check the trips of a school day
useCases.text: List the scheduled, running and completed trips, filtered by day, status, route or campus. Open one trip to read its times and stops.

useCases.title: Prepare the boarding list for a trip
useCases.text: Read the manifest of a trip: each pupil with status and last event, grouped by stop. Read the route to check its ordered stops.

useCases.title: Review incidents and SOS alerts
useCases.text: List incidents and SOS alerts, newest first, with severity, status, bus, trip and driver.

useCases.title: Look up a pupil's class and route
useCases.text: Read pupils with their class, campus and route assignment. Guardian and emergency contact details are never returned.
